findings.title: Scope sanity check 'Are explicit exclusions documented?' does not fail when Out of scope is empty: the system pre-check returns 'unknown' (rendered as Unknown) instead of failing, contrary to the REQ-PB-031 acceptance and B0041
findings.reproduction: Disposable stack built from candidate sha256:089a2a2f… (PostgreSQL 16.13, migrations 0001-0019, AUTH_MODE=dev, synthetic users). As dev.lead: POST /api/v1/transformations {mode: end_to_end}; POST /transformations/{id}/charter {transformationName, inScope: 'Synthetic retail billing', caseForChange} (Out of scope left empty); GET /transformations/{id}/charter. Output: outOfScope = null; scopeCheckPrechecks[exclusions_documented] = {result: 'unknown', detail: 'No exclusions (out of scope) are recorded yet.'}. Code: apps/api/src/modules/transformations/charter.ts:250-253 (`case "exclusions_present": out_of_scope === null ? unknown : pass`), which ADR-0017 §2 mirrors. The integration test apps/api/test/integration/registers.test.ts:90 asserts ['exclusions_documented','unknown']. The UI (CharterPage) renders the result as the neutral 'Unknown' badge. Script and log: docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-2/probe-exclusions.mjs.txt, probe-exclusions.log.
findings.expected: REQ-PB-031 acceptance: 'an empty Out of scope field makes "Are explicit exclusions documented?" fail'. An empty Out of scope on a saved charter is a definite answer to B0041 (no exclusions are documented), not missing data. The pre-check should report a failing/attention result (for example result 'attention' or a dedicated 'fail', with a clear 'No explicit exclusions are documented' message in EN and AR). It should not report 'unknown'.
findings.actual: result 'unknown' / UI badge 'Unknown'. The check does not fail; it reads as 'not enough data'. It never shows green, so the Unknown-never-green invariant holds, but the acceptance criterion is not met and the B0041 negative is not surfaced as a failure.

history.note: raised by domain-reviewer DG2 round 2; reproduced live through the API on a disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 stack (probe-exclusions.log); the web pre-check badge also needs updating (frontend-ux-engineer) once the API result changes

findings.title: Product gate titles repeat the gate code ('G2 – G2 - Direction') because the UI prefixes the code to the source gate name, which already contains it
findings.reproduction: Run apps/web/e2e/p2-journeys.spec.ts on the candidate (chromium-en/ar) and open /transformations/{id}/gates/G2 (screenshot docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-2/screens/en/p2-26-g2-approved.png): the card heading reads 'G2 – G2 - Direction'. Code: apps/web/src/pages/gates/GateDetailPage.tsx:74 and GatesPage.tsx:70 build `${def.code} – ${sourceNameEn|nameAr}`, while gate_definition.source_name_en is already 'G2 - Direction' (B0023; migration 0011). The same applies to G1-G6 in both languages.
findings.expected: The B0023 gate name is shown once, e.g. 'G2 - Direction' (and 'G2 - التوجّه' in Arabic).
findings.actual: 'G2 – G2 - Direction' (the code is duplicated) on the gate list and detail pages.
